A guide to following the @Sniper  channel  @here  @everyone  reposted for those who asked 

I trade 0dte contracts or 1 dte 
If I’m trading something right out the gate I will do my best. I  will let you know what I’m watching when I have if the price action allows for it . If not I’ll type it in @here but Please understand how fast  things move and by the time you see it the price could be up +5% or +10%. I am working on decreasing the latency of this and giving the trade idea beforehand .

if I haven’t alerted that I’m cutting and im not updating the position it means I am still in. If you want to spam emojis while waiting that’s fine but it won’t change anything. I will update you even if it’s an ugly loss -55% -90% -30% or small proper losses -5% -10% I am transparent with you about it . Like it or not every trader takes losses . Manage risk so it doesn’t hurt so bad . Please be prepared to lose 30-50% on any given trade minimum as this can happen in seconds on any 0dte that’s out of the money . I will do my best to cut for a 5% to 10% loss when I can but please know I can’t control the market and random news candles .

if im up in a position and have alerted several trims I have moved my stop loss to break even , this means that if I stopped alerting a trim and the price action reverses after trimming in profit  I am usually out of the position at break even . This ensures that a green trade can never go red . Breaking this rule often nets me negative results .

If I am down in a position and have not said to add that means don’t add , if I did add , manage your risk . Never size so heavy that you can’t add one time .  I will always try not to add to a position but once in a while it makes sense to average down and I do. If it goes against you please manage your own risk . understand trading is a game of probabilities where wins outweigh losses .
